method.coordinates: zero-based x,y relative to upper left of decoded, unregistered images
method.strong_edge: Sobel magnitude divided by 8 >= 8 RGB8 codes/pixel, followed by 4-direction nonmaximum suppression. The frame perimeter is excluded from the binary edge map.
method.edge_match: For each strong candidate center, a reference center within Euclidean distance <= 2 pixels is a hit for precision. Reverse roles for recall. F1 is the harmonic mean. With tolerance, several centers may match one. Edges and distances are computed over the whole image before selecting ROI centers.
method.short_edge_pixels: Number of thinned strong edge centers in eight-connected components of one to eight centers. Whole-frame component labeling before cropping.
method.isolated_dark_pixels: Center luminance is at least three codes below every immediate axial neighbor.
method.connected_f1: Select 8-connected components containing at least 24 thinned strong edge centers independently in candidate and reference. Compute precision/recall/F1 on those retained centers with the same two-pixel tolerance. Connectivity is computed before cropping.
method.flat_components: Label eight-connected components of the 5x5 flat-interior map independently inside each reported ROI. Report largest component area divided by ROI area and count of component areas 32 through 1024 pixels inclusive. Crop edges can truncate a component. Use as a same-crop proxy for overmerging; connected smooth interiors can contain gradients.
method.surface_area: All candidates use positions where the centered 17x17 window contains no thinned strong reference edge center. The mask is computed on the whole frame before cropping.
method.transition_pct: Smooth each RGB8 channel with a Gaussian of sigma 2.5 pixels. At each center compare opposite flanks separated by 12 pixels horizontally and vertically. Take the maximum absolute difference over the six direction/channel combinations. Count positions where the difference is 6 through 24 codes inclusive and divide by surface_area. This measures medium-contrast changes on smoothed surfaces, including soft gradients; it is not a count of distinct patches.
method.surface_transition_f1: Exact-location overlap between candidate and reference 12-pixel surface transitions inside the same reference-defined mask. F1 = 2 times intersection / sum of counts. A null indicates both sets were empty.
method.surface_band_mae: Signed differences of Gaussian responses (sigma 2.5 minus sigma 9, in pixels) are computed per RGB8 channel. Luma band MAE compares the signed luma response against the reference over surface_area. Chroma band MAE averages the absolute errors of red minus green and green minus blue signed band responses. Lower is closer. Local features from the JPEG include effects of compression.
method.medium_rms: RMS of the signed difference of two Gaussian-filtered luminance images at sigma 1.8 and 6.0 pixels, in RGB8 codes. This measures the amount of medium-scale structure.
method.isolated_extrema: Center Y=(R+2G+B+2)//4 is at least three codes higher or lower than all four immediate axial neighbors. Counts also include legitimate point features.
method.flat_pct: Percentage of centers where the maximum minus minimum value is at most 4 codes in each of R, G and B over a 5x5 window. Frame-border samples replicate.
method.rgb: MAE is mean absolute 8-bit RGB channel error. PSNR uses all RGB samples with peak 255. Exact requires all three channels equal. Gradient magnitude MAE uses the normalized Sobel magnitudes before thinning.
